summary: gather_facts' parallel option controls running fact modules in parallel or serially; it defaults to true with multiple modules and can be set via ansible_facts_parallel.
questions: How do I make fact modules run in order?
Is parallel fact gathering always faster?
What variable controls parallel fact gathering?

answer_card.title: gather_facts parallel option
answer_card.answer_md: `parallel`: run fact modules in parallel (default true if more than one) or serially in order (guarantees merge order). Not always faster for cheap modules. Override with `ansible_facts_parallel` (direct task option wins).
